title: AgentFlow — Journeys
description: Paste a case/loop/run id; open a trace_id in Traces.

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT timestamp, serviceName, name, round(duration_nano / 1e6, 2) AS duration_ms, has_error, status_message, attributes_string['af.error.reason'] AS error_reason, trace_id FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE (attributes_string['af.case_id'] = {{.case_id}} OR {{.case_id}} = '') AND (attributes_string['af.loop_id'] = {{.loop_id}} OR {{.loop_id}} = '') AND (attributes_string['af.workflow_run_id'] = {{.workflow_run_id}} OR {{.workflow_run_id}} = '') AND (trace_id = {{.trace_id}} OR {{.trace_id}} = '') AND ({{.case_id}} != '' OR {{.loop_id}} != '' OR {{.workflow_run_id}} != '' OR {{.trace_id}} != '') AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_datetime}} AND {{.end_datetime}} AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 500

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT fromUnixTimestamp64Nano(toInt64(timestamp)) AS time, severity_text, body, trace_id FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2 WHERE (attributes_string['af.case_id'] = {{.case_id}} OR {{.case_id}} = '') AND (attributes_string['af.loop_id'] = {{.loop_id}} OR {{.loop_id}} = '') AND (attributes_string['af.workflow_run_id'] = {{.workflow_run_id}} OR {{.workflow_run_id}} = '') AND (trace_id = {{.trace_id}} OR {{.trace_id}} = '') AND ({{.case_id}} != '' OR {{.loop_id}} != '' OR {{.workflow_run_id}} != '' OR {{.trace_id}} != '') AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp_nano}} AND {{.end_timestamp_nano}} AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 500

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT timestamp, serviceName, name, status_message, attributes_string['af.error.reason'] AS error_reason, trace_id FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE has_error = true AND (attributes_string['af.case_id'] = {{.case_id}} OR {{.case_id}} = '') AND (attributes_string['af.loop_id'] = {{.loop_id}} OR {{.loop_id}} = '') AND (attributes_string['af.workflow_run_id'] = {{.workflow_run_id}} OR {{.workflow_run_id}} = '') AND (trace_id = {{.trace_id}} OR {{.trace_id}} = '') AND ({{.case_id}} != '' OR {{.loop_id}} != '' OR {{.workflow_run_id}} != '' OR {{.trace_id}} != '') AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_datetime}} AND {{.end_datetime}} AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 500

clickhouse_sql.name: A
clickhouse_sql.query: SELECT trace_id, min(timestamp) AS first_seen, argMin(name, timestamp) AS root_span FROM signoz_traces.distributed_signoz_index_v3 WHERE (attributes_string['af.case_id'] = {{.case_id}} OR {{.case_id}} = '') AND (attributes_string['af.loop_id'] = {{.loop_id}} OR {{.loop_id}} = '') AND (attributes_string['af.workflow_run_id'] = {{.workflow_run_id}} OR {{.workflow_run_id}} = '') AND (trace_id = {{.trace_id}} OR {{.trace_id}} = '') AND ({{.case_id}} != '' OR {{.loop_id}} != '' OR {{.workflow_run_id}} != '' OR {{.trace_id}} != '') AND timestamp BETWEEN {{.start_datetime}} AND {{.end_datetime}} AND ts_bucket_start BETWEEN {{.start_timestamp}} - 1800 AND {{.end_timestamp}} GROUP BY trace_id ORDER BY first_seen LIMIT 100
